title: Yellow triangel - no data?
symptom: Main screen shows 'no data' for varying minutes (e.g., 521, 412) while bolus calculator has the newest value from XDrip. A yellow triangle appears on the screen, and re-calculation doesn't help. Occurs intermittently, not related to flight mode.
cause: The yellow triangle is normal for Libre 2 because readings from xDrip are not sent exactly every 5 minutes. The cause of the missing data on main screen is not identified in the thread.
fix: No definitive fix provided. MilosKozak suggests testing the dev branch as many bugs of this kind are fixed there.
evidence_quote: the yellow triangle is "normal" for libre 2, since the readings from xDrip are not sent exactly every 5 minutes.
